# beowulf-fitt-07 — Fitt VII · Hrothgar’s Welcome (lines 456–498)

43 lines, Klaeber printed pages 18, 19.

## The lines

```
 456  Hrōðgār maþelode, helm Scyldinga:
 457  ‘For [g]ewy[r]htum þū, wine mīn Bēowulf,
 458  ond for ārstafum ūsic sōhtest.
 459  Geslōh þīn fæder fǣhðe mǣste;
 460  wearþ hē Heaþolāfe tō handbonan
 461  mid Wilfingum; ðā hine Wedera cyn
 462  for herebrōgan habban ne mihte.
 463  Þanon hē gesōhte Sūð-Dena folc
 464  ofer ȳða gewealc, Ār-Scyldinga;
 465  ðā ic furþum wēold folce Deniga
 466  ond on geogoðe hēold ginne rīce,
 467  hordburh hæleþa; ðā wæs Heregār dēad,
 468  mīn yldra mǣg unlifigende,
 469  bearn Healfdenes; sē wæs betera ðonne ic!
 470  Siððan þā fǣhðe fēo þingode;
 471  sende ic Wylfingum ofer wæteres hrycg
 472  ealde mādmas; hē mē āþas swōr.
 473  Sorh is mē tō secgan on sefan mīnum
 474  gumena ǣngum, hwæt mē Grendel hafað
 475  hȳnðo on Heorote mid his heteþancum,
 476  fǣrnīða gefremed; is mīn fletwerod,
 477  wīghēap gewanod; hīe wyrd forswēop
 478  on Grendles gryre. God ēaþe mæg
 479  þone dolsceaðan dǣda getwǣfan!
 480  Ful oft gebēotedon bēore druncne
 481  ofer ealowǣge ōretmecgas,
 482  þæt hīe in bēorsele bīdan woldon
 483  Grendles gūþe mid gryrum ecga.
 484  Ðonne wæs þēos medoheal on morgentīd,
 485  drihtsele drēorfāh, þonne dæg līxte,
 486  eal bencþelu blōde bestȳmed,
 487  heall heorudrēore; āhte ic holdra þȳ lǣs,
 488  dēorre duguðe, þē þā dēað fornam.
 489  Site nū tō symle ond onsǣl meoto,
 490  sigehrēð secgum, swā þīn sefa hwette.’
 491  Þā wæs Gēatmæcgum geador ætsomne
 492  on bēorsele benc gerȳmed;
 493  þǣr swīðferhþe sittan ēodon,
 494  þrȳðum dealle. Þegn nytte behēold,
 495  sē þe on handa bær hroden ealowǣge,
 496  scencte scīr wered. Scop hwīlum sang
 497  hādor on Heorote. Þǣr wæs hæleða drēam,
 498  duguð unlȳtel Dena ond Wedera.
```
